Resolves #20217

`Collection#splice(0, count, items)` now leaves exactly the added items. The full-clear optimization replaced `me._items` but left the method's local `items` on the removed array, and the add path wrote there. Below the 5,000-item threshold the collection ended empty; above it, the removed items came back. Pointing the local at the new array (`items = me._items = []`) fixes both, and the `TreeStore` replace-all that #20213 routed through this path with it.

Evidence: L1 (unit tier in Node) → L1 required (AC-1 to AC-4 are unit-level).

## AC Evidence
| AC-1 | `test/playwright/unit/collection/SpliceReplaceAll.spec.mjs`: exactly the added items, in order, with `removedItems` the old ones (red on `dev`: count 0); above the threshold no removed item returns (red on `dev`: 5,004 for 5,001) |
| AC-2 | `test/playwright/unit/data/TreeStoreClear.spec.mjs` › `a replace-all keeps the nodes it adds` (red on `dev`: count 0) |
| AC-3 | the existing `TreeStoreClear.spec.mjs` arms, scan counts included, pass unchanged |
| AC-4 | the full unit tier on this branch: 5,656 passed, 2 skipped; the one unrelated failure is below. CI runs it again |

### 🧭 Patch-Blind Premise Snapshot

*   **Inputs Read Before Patch:** Ticket #20217, `src/collection/Base.mjs` (`splice`, lines 1532–1658), `src/data/TreeStore.mjs` (`splice`, lines 1103–1285), and Memory Core records (`4afdc511-ab8d-4ef6-9d76-2ba92f026a2a`, `94c2da9b-6485-4af1-8a69-31bbe3c268af`, `afd760b7-9e9d-435d-a009-f17512663a64`, `5df6539c-ba92-41e7-b9a7-68d966943046`).
*   **Expected Solution Shape:** In `src/collection/Base.mjs`, the full-clear branch (`if (index === 0 && removeCountAtIndex === me.count)`) must rebind the local `items` reference to the new empty array (`items = me._items = []`) after `removedItems = items`, so the subsequent addition branch enters `if (!items || items.length === 0) { me._items = addedItems }` instead of mutating or concatenating onto `removedItems`. It must not leak `TreeStore` awareness into `Collection` or allocate an intermediate copy, and unit tests must cover `Collection` (both sides of the 5,000-item threshold) and `TreeStore` replace-all.
*   **Patch Verdict:** Matches the expected shape (`src/collection/Base.mjs:1579` sets `items = me._items = []`, `test/playwright/unit/collection/SpliceReplaceAll.spec.mjs` pins `Collection#splice` at 2 and 5,001 added items, and `test/playwright/unit/data/TreeStoreClear.spec.mjs` pins `TreeStore#splice` replace-all).
*   **Premise Coherence:** Coheres with `friction->gold` and `verify-before-assert`: a review-time `defect-note` on #20213 was empirically verified against `dev` (`7e026ef22d`), promoted when proved reachable via `TreeStore` replace-all, and fixed at the base `Collection` primitive.
